title: Marcos welcomes Trump to Malacañang | The wRap
summary: Today’s headlines: Donald Trump, Pax Silica, COP31

blocks.text: Here are today’s headlines – the latest news in the Philippines and around the world:

items: Marcos rolls out red carpet for Trump state visit

blocks.text: U.S. President Donald Trump receives a red-carpet welcome in Malacañang with cultural performances on his arrival for a state visit in the Philippines.

items: Trump announces ‘biggest trade deal’ between Philippines, US

blocks.text: U.S. President Donald Trump announces ‘the biggest trade deal’ between the Philippines and the United States.

items: NUPL seeks release of anti-Pax Silica protesters detained for over 36 hours

blocks.text: Lawyers facilitate the release of 236 detained protesters from Southern Tagalog on Wednesday night, November 18, after an order from a Muntinlupa court.

items: COP31 AI pledge fails to lure US Big Tech

blocks.text: China’s Alibaba is the only major tech company so far to sign a United Nations-backed pledge to reduce AI’s environmental impact.

items: PH police file criminal complaints vs Thomas Markle, father of Meghan

blocks.text: Philippine police say criminal complaints have been filed against Thomas Markle, the estranged father of Britain’s Duchess of Sussex Meghan Markle. – Rappler.com
